tools.name: media_download
tools.description: Download a direct public HTTPS image, video, audio or font URL and add it to this project. Media uses the editor's regular import, save and turn undo; fonts use project fonts and are not timeline undo. At most 300 MiB per media file, 2 MiB per font, 20 transfers / 1 GiB per turn. Accepts direct files, not video web pages; ask for the source file or its direct URL when needed. Returns a durable job ID. Reuse job after a saved result or conflict; failed/cancelled transfers require explicit retry:true. A handled job never re-adds a removed/undone file. Use media_downloads to find previous results. Read mode cannot download.

tools.name: media_import
tools.description: Import an exact registered brand asset URL from brand_read or a recent:<id> handle from media_search into this project. Browser-local files/folders use the editor Media + picker. No arbitrary server paths. Uses regular project import/save/turn undo and durable job results. Fonts go to project fonts outside timeline undo. Use job to continue a retained result; retry:true explicitly restarts a failed transfer. A handled job never resurrects removed/undone media.

tools.name: media_downloads
tools.description: Read up to 40 recent project media download/import jobs, including retained results not yet imported. Pass job for one result. Read-only; use media_download or media_import with its job ID to resume. Terminal jobs will not restart without explicit retry:true.
